signed_in_chrome_live_test.fixture: Two loopback pages that record input events and release a shared completion marker once both expected inputs arrive.
signed_in_chrome_live_test.initial_regression: Turn cleanup dropped ownership of a still-open current tab in its mate group. The other mate listed it after the original turn ended.
signed_in_chrome_live_test.fix: Keep ownership of the current tab if it remains in the mate group. Keep ownership when Chrome reports a transient cleanup error.
signed_in_chrome_live_test.refusal: Tab belongs to another browser worker.
observations: The initial click-based check hit the page takeover guard. The successful retest recorded input events without requiring a click.
The open response omitted the tab ID when it returned a page snapshot. Both mates recovered using the scoped tabs list.
After the explicit show call selected Searchy’s tab, extra keystrokes reached its field. The trace shows no mate typing action at that time.
The fixture tabs remain visible because Chrome prompts to delete their synced groups when closing the last tab.
